points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 雅克·拉康1901年出生于巴黎一个富裕的中产阶级家庭。他在巴黎接受早期教育，展现出对文学和哲学的浓厚兴趣。1919年，拉康进入巴黎高等师范学院(École Normale Supérieure)学习，这所精英学府培养了许多法国知识分子。在此期间，他深入研究黑格尔、克尔凯郭尔和尼采等哲学家的著作，同时学习精神分析学，对弗洛伊德的理论产生浓厚兴趣。这段时期奠定了他后来融合哲学与精神分析的理论基础。
points.descriptionEn: Jacques Lacan was born in 1901 into a wealthy middle-class family in Paris. He received his early education in Paris, showing a strong interest in literature and philosophy. In 1919, Lacan entered the École Normale Supérieure, an elite institution that produced many French intellectuals. During this time, he deeply studied the works of philosophers such as Hegel, Kierkegaard, and Nietzsche, while also learning psychoanalysis and developing a keen interest in Freud's theories. This period laid the foundation for his later work that would merge philosophy and psychoanalysis.

points.title: 精神分析实践
points.description: 1926年，拉康开始在巴黎圣安妮医院(St. Anne Hospital)担任精神病医生，并开始接受精神分析训练。他受到当时著名精神分析师拉帕波特(Rapaport)和斯特劳斯(Strauss)的指导。在此期间，拉康开始将精神分析与语言学、数学等学科结合，发展出自己独特的分析方法。1932年，他提交了博士论文《论妄想性精神病及其与人格的关系》，探讨了精神分裂症患者的语言和思维模式，这标志着他开始形成自己独特的理论视角，将弗洛伊德的精神分析与结构主义语言学初步结合。
points.descriptionEn: In 1926, Lacan began working as a psychiatrist at Sainte-Anne Hospital in Paris and started receiving psychoanalytic training. He was guided by prominent psychoanalysts such as Rudolph Loewenstein and Sacha Nacht. During this period, Lacan began integrating psychoanalysis with linguistics, mathematics, and other disciplines, developing his unique analytical approach. In 1932, he submitted his doctoral thesis 'On Paranoic Psychosis and Its Relations to the Personality,' exploring the language and thought patterns of schizophrenic patients. This marked the beginning of his formation of a unique theoretical perspective that would merge Freudian psychoanalysis with structural linguistics.

points.title: 理论发展期
points.description: 1931年，拉康成为巴黎精神分析学会正式会员，开始了他的精神分析职业生涯。二战期间，拉康在维希法国的维希市继续行医，同时参与抵抗运动。战后，他重返巴黎，在圣安妮医院继续工作，并在巴黎大学任教。这一时期，拉康开始系统性地重新诠释弗洛伊德的理论，引入语言学概念，提出'镜像阶段'理论，并开始发展他的'回归弗洛伊德'运动。1951年，他创办了'巴黎弗洛伊德事业'(The Freudian Field of Paris)研讨班，每周在圣安娜医院举办讲座，吸引了众多知识分子和学者。
points.descriptionEn: In 1931, Lacan became a full member of the Paris Psychoanalytic Society, beginning his psychoanalytic career. During World War II, Lacan continued his practice in Vichy, France, while also participating in the Resistance movement. After the war, he returned to Paris, continued working at Sainte-Anne Hospital, and taught at the University of Paris. During this period, Lacan began systematically reinterpreting Freudian theory, introducing linguistic concepts, proposing his 'mirror stage' theory, and developing his 'return to Freud' movement. In 1951, he founded 'The Freudian Field of Paris' seminar series, holding weekly lectures at Sainte-Anne Hospital that attracted numerous intellectuals and scholars.

points.place: 巴黎高等研究实践学院
points.title: 研讨班时期
points.description: 1953年，拉康因与巴黎精神分析学会的分歧而被暂停分析师资格，同年他创办了自己的研讨班，在巴黎高等研究实践学院(École Pratique des Hautes Études)任教。这一时期是拉康思想成熟的关键阶段，他每周举办研讨班，系统阐述他的理论，包括'想象界、象征界、实在界'的三界理论，'能指'概念，以及'欲望'理论。他的研讨班吸引了包括哲学家、文学批评家、精神分析师在内的众多听众，成为巴黎知识界的重要事件。1959年，拉康提出'回归弗洛伊德'的口号，强调重新发现弗洛伊德著作中被忽视的方面，这一时期他的理论影响力不断扩大，但也引发了更多争议。
points.descriptionEn: In 1953, Lacan was suspended from the International Psychoanalytic Association due to conflicts with the Paris Psychoanalytic Society. The same year, he founded his own seminar series and began teaching at the École Pratique des Hautes Études. This period was crucial for the maturation of Lacan's thought, as he systematically developed his theories in weekly seminars, including his theory of the 'imaginary, symbolic, and real orders,' the concept of the 'signifier,' and his theory of desire. His seminars attracted a diverse audience including philosophers, literary critics, and psychoanalysts, becoming a major event in Parisian intellectual life. In 1959, Lacan proposed the slogan 'return to Freud,' emphasizing the rediscovery of neglected aspects of Freud's work. During this period, his theoretical influence expanded significantly but also generated more controversy.

points.place: 巴黎弗洛伊德事业学校
points.title: 理论成熟与争议
points.description: 1964年，拉康被国际精神分析协会除名后，他创立了巴黎弗洛伊德事业学校(École Freudienne de Paris)，并继续举办研讨班，直至1981年去世。这一时期，拉康的理论达到成熟，他提出了'实在界'(the Real)、'象征界'(the Symbolic)和'想象界'(the Imaginary)的三界理论，以及'能指链'和'欲望的辩证法'等核心概念。他的思想对后结构主义、女性主义批评、电影理论等领域产生深远影响。然而，他的理论也因其晦涩难懂和与主流精神分析学的分歧而备受争议。1979年，巴黎弗洛伊德事业学校解散，但拉康的思想通过他的学生和追随者继续传播，形成了'拉康派'精神分析运动，影响遍及全球。
points.descriptionEn: In 1964, after being expelled from the International Psychoanalytic Association, Lacan founded the École Freudienne de Paris and continued his seminar series until his death in 1981. During this period, Lacan's theory reached maturity with his development of the concepts of the 'Real,' 'Symbolic,' and 'Imaginary orders,' as well as core ideas like the 'chain of signifiers' and the 'dialectic of desire.' His thought had a profound influence on post-structuralism, feminist criticism, film theory, and other fields. However, his theories were also controversial due to their difficulty and divergence from mainstream psychoanalysis. In 1979, the École Freudienne de Paris dissolved, but Lacan's ideas continued to spread through his students and followers, forming the 'Lacanian' psychoanalytic movement with global influence.

appraisal.zh: 拉康通常被视为二十世纪最具原创性的精神分析思想家之一，他把弗洛伊德学说与结构主义语言学、哲学熔于一炉，以「回归弗洛伊德」重提语言与无意识的关系，其研讨班深刻影响了后结构主义、女性主义批评与电影理论。不过他的文本以晦涩著称，理论被指过于抽象、脱离临床且难以验证，与主流学会的冲突终至被国际精神分析协会除名，也有研究者指出他轻视情感、身体与社会因素，个人生活中的伦理问题亦屡遭议论。
appraisal.en: Lacan is generally seen as one of the most original psychoanalytic thinkers of the twentieth century, fusing Freud with structural linguistics and philosophy; his 'return to Freud' re-centred the relation between language and the unconscious, and his seminars shaped post-structuralism, feminist criticism and film theory. Yet his writing is notoriously obscure, his theory faulted as abstract, detached from clinical practice and hard to verify, and his conflicts with the mainstream culminated in expulsion from the International Psychoanalytic Association; some researchers add that he neglected emotion, the body and social factors, while his personal conduct has drawn ethical controversy.

supporter.zh: 拉康被视为20世纪最具创新性的思想家之一，他成功地将弗洛伊德的精神分析与结构主义语言学、哲学等学科融合，开创了精神分析理论的新范式。他的'回归弗洛伊德'运动重新发现了被传统精神分析忽视的维度，特别是语言与无意识的关系。拉康的理论为理解主体性、性别认同、欲望结构提供了深刻洞见，影响了后结构主义、女性主义批评、电影理论等多个领域。他的研讨班成为法国知识界的重要事件，培养了一代知识分子，其思想遗产至今仍在学术界产生深远影响。
supporter.en: Lacan is regarded as one of the most innovative thinkers of the 20th century, successfully merging Freudian psychoanalysis with structural linguistics, philosophy, and other disciplines to create a new paradigm in psychoanalytic theory. His 'return to Freud' movement rediscovered dimensions neglected by traditional psychoanalysis, particularly the relationship between language and the unconscious. Lacan's theories offer profound insights into subjectivity, gender identity, and the structure of desire, influencing post-structuralism, feminist criticism, film theory, and other fields. His seminars became major events in French intellectual life,培养了一代知识分子，其思想遗产至今仍在学术界产生深远影响。

critic.zh: 拉康的理论受到多方面批评。首先，他的著作极其晦涩难懂，充满了专业术语和复杂的隐喻，使许多读者难以理解。其次，他的理论被认为过于抽象和形式化，脱离了临床实践，缺乏可验证性。第三，拉康与主流精神分析学会的冲突不断，最终被国际精神分析协会除名，这反映了他的理论与传统精神分析学的根本分歧。此外，批评者认为拉康过度强调语言和结构，忽视了情感、身体和社会因素在心理发展中的作用。他的个人生活也备受争议，包括与患者的性关系等伦理问题。
critic.en: Lacan's theories have faced numerous criticisms. First, his work is notoriously difficult to understand, filled with specialized terminology and complex metaphors. Second, his theories are considered overly abstract and formalized, detached from clinical practice and lacking empirical verification. Third, his constant conflicts with mainstream psychoanalytic societies, culminating in his expulsion from the International Psychoanalytic Association, reflect fundamental disagreements between his theories and traditional psychoanalysis. Additionally, critics argue that Lacan overemphasized language and structure while neglecting the role of emotions, the body, and social factors in psychological development. His personal life also generated controversy, including ethical issues regarding sexual relationships with patients.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，拉康被定义为一位复杂而矛盾的思想家，既是精神分析领域的革新者，也是争议人物。他的理论超越了传统的学科界限，成为后现代思想的重要组成部分。在学术界，拉康被视为结构主义和后结构主义的关键人物，他的思想影响了德里达、福柯、克里斯蒂娃等众多思想家。在流行文化中，拉康的名字常与复杂的理论、晦涩的文本联系在一起，成为知识分子和艺术家的灵感来源。尽管他的理论难以理解，但拉康对无意识、语言和主体性的深刻探索，使他成为20世纪思想史上不可忽视的重要人物。
objective.en: In historical and popular culture contexts, Lacan is defined as a complex and contradictory figure—both an innovator in psychoanalysis and a controversial figure. His theories transcended traditional disciplinary boundaries, becoming an important component of postmodern thought. In academia, Lacan is regarded as a key figure in structuralism and post-structuralism, influencing numerous thinkers such as Derrida, Foucault, and Kristeva. In popular culture, Lacan's name is often associated with complex theories and difficult texts, serving as an inspiration for intellectuals and artists. Despite the difficulty of understanding his theories, Lacan's profound exploration of the unconscious, language, and subjectivity makes him an indispensable figure in 20th-century intellectual history.

self.zh: 无意识像语言一样被结构。
self.en: The unconscious is structured like a language.
